text:
emma: Quick triage — Sales received a request from NovaHealth for a 'dynamic reserve' pricing option. They want to commit 200k tokens/month, but be able to burst up to ~1M tokens with an auto-top cushion of credits. Asking for a single blended per-token rate + clear overage/credit rules. Can product weigh in?

tyler-sales: They want simple billing and 99.9% latency SLA. Will sign if pricing is straightforward and we can guarantee start in ~6 weeks.

ken-finance: Need numbers: expected avg vs spike (95th pct), definitions for credits (do they expire, rollover?), and invoice cadence. Also need margin target.

liz-legal: Any data residency or audit requirements from NovaHealth? If PHI involved, we need to flag Private deployment.

ran-engineering: Technical constraints checklist: how do we implement burst — route to Dedicated or hosted with burst pool? Cache/kv persistence during fallback? Also per-customer token cushions in the charging pipeline. Need rough eng estimate.

emma: Proposal sketch so we have something concrete for sales/finance:
Option A — ReservedFlex SKU: base_commit 200k tokens/mo @ fixed per-token rate, plus a burst cushion bucket (up to 800k tokens) billed as "credits" consumed at a premium. Overages beyond cushion billed at higher overage rate.
Option B — Blended rate: a single blended per-token price that assumes expected burst, reconciled monthly with credits top-up if actual > blended. Simpler billing but risk to margin.

emma: Acceptance criteria for shipping pilot: 1) sample invoice calc for both options with examples, 2) clear billing events (commit, cushion use, overage), 3) console UI to configure cushion size and expiration, 4) routing policy documented (hosted vs dedicated fallback), 5) rollout checklist + fallback SLA.

emma: quick calc example (illustrative):
```
ReservedFlex example:
base_commit = 200,000 tokens @ $0.007/token = $1,400/mo
cushion = 800,000 tokens consumed at +20% premium -> $0.0084/token -> $6,720 if fully used
blended if cushion used 400k = ((200k*0.007)+(400k*0.0084))/600k =~ $0.0076/token
```

samir-pm: Ask: Are we prioritizing revenue/profitability (Option A) or go-to-market simplicity (Option B)? My vote: pilot with Option B for 3 customers to iterate quickly, but only if legal/finance guardrails ok.

tyler-sales: Customer timeline — they want to start pilot in 6 weeks, but prefer an 8-week firm commitment. Can we hit that with a minimal scope?

emma: Decision: run a customer pilot. Next steps / owners: 
- emma: PRD + acceptance criteria (due Tue)
- ran-engineering: infra & routing estimate (EOW)
- ken-finance: margin & invoice template + credit expiry rules (Wed)
- liz-legal: contract clause draft for cushion/overage + data residency check (Wed)
- tyler-sales: confirm pilot SOW and timeline with NovaHealth (ASAP)

ran-engineering: Heads-up — implementing per-customer cushions requires changes to meter pipeline and billing events. Ballpark: 2 sprint effort for core infra + 1 sprint for console UI if prioritized. If deprioritized, prototype using manual billing adjustments.

ken-finance: Rough margin target: to hit 30% gross margin assume blended target ~$0.0065/token given expected burst profile (subject to confirmation). I'll post a spreadsheet in FIN ticket.

tyler-sales: I'll push for 8-week start and try to lock a 6-month pilot with usage reporting.

billing-bot: Created FIN ticket FIN-4321 for pricing model and margin calc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4321 :white_check_mark:

emma: Thanks — will draft PRD and link FIN/ENG tickets. Ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
